sentences.text: This review covers wellbore 15/9-F-4 (Sodir wellbore 5693), an injection well on the VOLVE field, with reports from 2007-06-09 to 2016-10-13.
The first report without a before-spud flag is dated 2007-10-13, which is also the Sodir entry date.
The report span is 3289.0 days, with 124 active days across 130 reports; 6 reports carry a before-spud flag.
The wellbore has 5 campaigns.
The deepest reported depth is 3510.0 m measured depth and 3138.8 m true vertical depth; Sodir gives the same total depth of 3510.0 m.
Total activity time is 2859.0 h.
Primary lost time is 431.25 h, which is 15.08% of the activity time. Possible lost time of 279.5 h (9.78% of activity time) is reported separately and is not included in the primary figure.

The main outcome was a well drilled to 3510.0 m MD and completed by the Sodir completion date of 2008-03-09, after a wireline fishing operation that cost 138.5 h of primary lost time. Later campaigns were workovers, wireline work and a plug and abandonment, and the last report is dated 2016-10-13; Sodir lists the status as P&A.
Campaign 1 ran from 2007-10-13 to 2007-11-05, spanning 24.04 days with 24 active days; its dominant operation phase is drilling.
Campaign 2 ran from 2008-02-04 to 2008-04-22, spanning 78.96 days with 77 active days; its dominant operation phase is drilling.
Campaign 3 ran from 2010-09-23 to 2010-09-26, spanning 4.0 days with 4 active days; its dominant operation phase is workover.
Campaign 4 ran from 2012-09-11 to 2012-09-15, spanning 5.0 days with 5 active days; its dominant operation phase is workover.
Campaign 5 ran from 2016-09-30 to 2016-10-13, spanning 14.0 days with 14 active days; its dominant operation phase is plug abandon.

Section 1 was drilled with a 36 in hole from 2007-06-09 to 2007-06-13, from 145.6 m to 256.5 m MD, adding 110.9 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 3.96 m/h; the TVD at section end is 256.5 m.
Section 2 (36 in hole) ran on 2007-10-12 at 256.5 m MD with no new hole and no coded drilling time, so no drilling rate is reported.

Section 3 was drilled with a 17.5 in hole from 2007-10-13 to 2007-10-22, from 260.0 m to 1360.0 m MD, adding 1103.5 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 15.49 m/h; the TVD at section end is 1334.0 m.

Section 4 was drilled with a 12.25 in hole from 2007-10-23 to 2007-11-05, from 1363.0 m to 2770.0 m MD, adding 1410.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 12.88 m/h; the TVD at section end is 2607.6 m.
Section 5 (12.25 in hole) ran from 2008-02-04 to 2008-02-08 at 2770.0 m MD; no new hole was drilled and no drilling rate is reported.

Section 6 was drilled with an 8.5 in hole from 2008-02-09 to 2008-02-27, from 2774.0 m to 3510.0 m MD, adding 740.0 m of new hole at an average coded drilling rate of 9.83 m/h; the TVD at section end is 3138.8 m.
Section 7 ran from 2008-02-28 to 2008-03-13 at 3510.0 m MD with no new hole; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown) and no drilling rate is reported.
Section 8 ran from 2008-03-14 to 2008-03-16 at 3510.0 m MD with no new hole; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 9 ran from 2008-03-17 to 2008-03-18 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 10 ran from 2008-03-19 to 2008-04-05 at 3510.0 m MD with no new hole and no coded drilling time; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 11 ran on 2008-04-06 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 12 ran from 2008-04-07 to 2008-04-10 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 13 ran on 2008-04-11 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 14 ran from 2008-04-12 to 2008-04-15 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 15 ran from 2008-04-16 to 2008-04-22 at 3510.0 m MD; its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 16 ran from 2010-09-23 to 2010-09-26; its end depth is not reported and its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 17 ran from 2012-09-11 to 2016-09-30; its start and end depths are not reported and its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).
Section 18 (plug abandon) ran from 2016-10-01 to 2016-10-13 from 3500.0 m MD; its end depth is not reported and its hole size is not reported (hole size source unknown).

Drilling rates are averages over all time coded as drilling -- drill, not on-bottom rates of penetration; sections 2, 5, 7 and 8 to 18 have no reported rate because they drilled no new hole or had no coded drilling time.
Section 1 has no casing shoe recorded at its start or end, and no casing was set in it.
Section 2 started below a casing shoe at 251.2 m and set no casing.
Section 3 started below the 251.2 m casing shoe and set casing with a shoe at 1351.9 m MD.
Section 4 started below the 1351.9 m casing shoe and set casing with a shoe at 2760.5 m MD.
Section 5 started below the 2760.5 m casing shoe and set no casing.
Section 6 started below the 2760.5 m casing shoe and set no casing; no casing shoe is recorded for it.
Section 7 started below the 2760.5 m casing shoe and set casing with a shoe at 3508.0 m MD; the activity comment records the casing run as "POOH with 7" liner hanger RT".
Section 8 started below the 3508.0 m casing shoe and no casing shoe is recorded for it.
The activity comment for section 10 records "RIH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing", but the section data give no casing shoe depth for that run.
Section 18 started below the 3508.0 m casing shoe and set no casing.
Primary lost time totals 431.25 h, which is 15.08% of the 2859.0 h of activity time for the wellbore.
By section, the largest primary losses are section 10 with 204.75 h (50.18% of that section's activity time) and section 6 with 170.25 h (45.52% of that section's activity time).

Other sections with primary lost time are section 15 with 19.25 h (12.44% of its activity time), section 4 with 15.5 h (4.78%), section 12 with 8.5 h (8.85%), section 18 with 4.25 h (1.7%), section 2 with 2.75 h (15.28%), section 3 with 2.75 h (1.16%), section 5 with 1.25 h (1.26%), section 7 with 1.0 h (0.28%) and section 11 with 1.0 h (4.17%).
By cause, primary lost time is 217.0 h of waiting on weather, 138.5 h of fishing (interruption -- fish), 36.25 h of repair, 20.25 h of drilling wait and 19.25 h of rig up and down.

Possible lost time, reported separately and not added to the primary figures, totals 279.5 h (9.78% of activity time): 137.0 h of other interruptions, 81.25 h of waiting, 40.75 h of maintenance and 20.5 h of workover waiting.
On 2008-02-17 the MDT logging run failed and was pulled inside the casing shoe, and the repair of its string continued into 2008-02-18.

On 2008-02-18 the wireline became stuck during the MDT run in section 6 and the fishing operation was coded as interruption -- fish, with 138.5 h of primary lost time; cut-and-thread recovery of the wireline began on 2008-02-19.
The wireline fish was caught on 2008-02-24 and the wireline was then released at its electrical weakpoint and pulled out of the hole on the same day.
The liner cement job was run on 2008-03-09, the date Sodir gives as the completion date, and took 2.5 h.
Section 10 ran from 2008-03-19 to 2008-04-05 and carried 204.75 h of primary weather waits; on 2008-04-05 a 12.0 h stop was coded as waiting on weather because of exhaust fumes on the drill floor.
On 2008-03-28 a drilling wait of 1.0 h (primary) was taken to inspect the wellhead area, where a support bracket on a flowline was found ripped off, and production start-up was not made.
On 2008-04-03 casing tong faults caused several possible-tier interruptions, including a 2.25 h troubleshooting activity that traced a load cell or amplifier fault.
On 2008-04-04 the tie-back adapter was tagged shallow, an overpull followed, and several attempts were needed before the tie-back adapter was entered; the spear slipped during make-up.
On 2008-04-04 the straddle cup tester leaked during the pressure test and no valid test was obtained; its cups were found with a reduced outside diameter when pulled.
During the 2010 workover, a broken bolt in a wheel caused a 1.5 h possible-tier wait on 2010-09-24.
During the 2012 workover, a 6.0 h possible-tier wait on 2012-09-12 was spent waiting for an electrician and the production handover.
The plug and abandonment cement job was pumped on 2016-10-02 and lasted 1.75 h; the cement was placed and squeezed into the perforations, and the cement plug was then pressure tested.

Wireline and logging tools need a tested spare set before entry: the MDT run lost 138.5 h to a stuck wireline in section 6, and the MDT pumps found faulty on 2008-02-18 left only one spare on the rig, so the next well should carry spare pumps and rehearse cut-and-thread fishing before the first run.

Weather and exhaust-fume limits must be planned into the programme: section 10 lost 204.75 h of primary time to waiting on weather, and the 12.0 h stop on 2008-04-05 was for exhaust fumes on the drill floor, so the next well should set exhaust and wind criteria for the gas turbines and schedule non-critical work into those waits.

Equipment checks before running casing and tie-back tools should be completed ahead of the run: the casing tong faults on 2008-04-03 and the tie-back adapter problems on 2008-04-04 were logged as possible-tier interruptions, with a 2.25 h troubleshooting activity on 2008-04-03, so tong load cells and tie-back adapter depth should be verified on the surface before the string is run.

Campaign planning should track the two lost-time tiers separately: primary lost time was 431.25 h (15.08% of activity time) and possible lost time was 279.5 h (9.78%), and the 81.25 h of possible waiting should not be allowed to hide the primary losses.

Handover and abandonment work should be planned with the production department: the 2008 completion had a flowline support bracket found damaged on 2008-03-28 that held up start-up for 1.0 h, and the 2012 workover waited 6.0 h on 2012-09-12 for the production handover, so the next well should agree the handover checks in advance.

row.comments: Pulled MDT tool from 3245 m to 2671 m MD inside 9 5/8" casing shoe. Troubleshot tool failure - negative.
Continued to work WL with max 12000 lbs pull. Observed movement of WL unit. Secured WL unit with chains. Checked sheave wheels on drillfloor.
Continued isolating and checking MDT string components as required.

Put 7200 lbs tension on WL. Fitted T-clamp on 7/48 cable and slacked off WL. Cut 7/48 cable with 5-6 m loose end and fitted spear on same. Fitted spearhead overshot and 2 x fishing weights to winch side of wireline. Removed sheave wheel from TDS. Removed sheave wheel from aft samson post.
RIH with 5" DP from 3202 m MD and caught fish at 3221 m MD. Set down ~5 MT on fish and observed indication of succesful catch on surface and downhole WL tension.
Released electrical weakpoint. Powered down logging unit.

Pumped 10 m3 base oil, 780 lpm / 80 bar and 15 m3 of 1.65 sg tuned spacer E+ at 665 lpm / 80 bar with mud pumps while rotating liner 15 rpm / 12 kNm. Lined up to cmt unit through cmt hose. Dropped dart to release bottom wiper plug. 

Mixed and pumped 15.9 m3 1.90 sg cement slurry at 680 lpm / 80 bar and displaced cement with 0.9 m3 freshwater to rig floor. Dropped dart to release top wiper plug. 

Lined up to rig pumps and pumped 19 stks before flag indicated dart had dropped. Displaced cement with 45 m3 OBM at 1200 lpm, 15 rpm / 15-18 kNm with full returns. Slowed down pump rate to 500 lpm after 1930 strks. FCP = 42 bar. Stopped pumping after 2052 + 19 = 2071 strks pumped. Observed torque increased to 26 kNm after 2071 strks pumped, but had no bump.

POOH with 7" liner hanger RT on 5 1/2" DP from 2667 m to 112 m MD.

RU rollers on HTS and cleared rig floor of excess equipment prior to LO pipe in singles. LO 13 stds of 5 1/2" DP 24.7 lbs/ft in singles. Pumped 3 m3 1.63 sg slug, 1000 lpm / 7 bar at 594 m.

Due to findings made by production department, halted operation for inspection in wellhead area. A support bracket on the F-12 flowline/piping was found to be ripped off. Mærsk rig management decided not to start production due to the circumstances. Further investigation/assessment needed before starting production.
RIH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing from surface to 108 m MD according to tally.
Attempted to make up connection, investigated missing torque reading on Mærsk system. Traced fault to be load cell or load cell amplifier.
Filled pipe with approx 1,8 m3 packer fluid prior to testing. Pressured up to 380 bar - observed leakage from B-annulus outlet - not able to obtain test.

Evaluated situation. Checked drawings for potential hang-ups. Checked tally and joints left on deck - ok. Made two attempt to index pipe before tagging again - same depth. Sudden overpull of 14 MT observed after pulling some 30 cm above tag depth.

Exhaust fumes on drillfoor and drillers cabin. Suspended drillfloor operations. Checked wind and conditions every 30 min. Monitored well from shaker control room.

Meanwhile :
-Cleaned and tidied in moonpool
-Cleaned and tidied in wellhead module
-Housekeeping in heavy tool store

21:30 - shut down gas turbines to get working conditions on drillfloor.
Waited due to broken bolt in the wheel for KWV. Mechanic attempted to chang bolt without success and found a temporary solution.

Waited on Mearsk electrician, prior to hook up all wireline units. Electrician busy with other jobs.
Meanwhile lifted BOP down to BOP deck through hatch on drill floor and prepared wireline equipment.

Lined up valves on the cement head, released bottom dart, mixed and pumped 13.6m3 1,90SG cement, 600l/min. Pressure 130 bar, decreasing to 90bar, indicating cement moving down in the tubing. Displaced lines w/ 0,9m3 of Hi-vis pill. Released top dart. Pumped 12,2m3 of Hi-vis (totally pumped 13,1m3 of Hi-vis). Displaced w/ 37,7m3 of sea water at initial rate of 1000lpm. Increased pumping rate to 1300l/min - 101bar. Reduced pumping rate in the end of displacement to 700l/min - 83bar. Switched to contamination pill. Observed rapid increase in pressure while pumping contamination pill indicating cement plugging into perforations. Shut down after having pumped 3,5m3 contamination pill, 111 bar and monitored WH pressure decline. Recorded final stabilized squeeze pressure of 60bar. Closed swab valve. 
Verified volumes pumped by checking volumes left in the pits and silos. Theoretical top of cement 2755mMD. DHSV was cycled 3 times after 30m3 of sea water displacement was pumped
